segments.t: Cinco minutos depois, ao redor do abajur aceso na varanda do quarto nove na Pousada do Pátio da Tília, em Portland, Tessa, Evelyn e Owen debruçam-se sobre a lata azul e latão aberta, segurando cada um uma pequena recordação dessa semana inesquecível. Ouçam primeiro a conversa por completo.
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe — both halves together!
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
And from Caleb and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Evelyn to add on top!
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
Look at Graham standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.
Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim — ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
Vamos percorrer agora cada uma dessas quatro lembranças, fala após fala.
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe — both halves together!
'Primeiro, entra na caixa a receita COMPLETA da torta de frutas vermelhas e amêndoas — as duas metades juntas!'
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
'Você selou no plástico à prova d'água E escreveu "MEL E RASPAS DE LARANJA" em letras maiúsculas?!'
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
'Os futuros confeiteiros a partir de trinta verões de hoje à noite merecem zero manchas de tinta e zero conchas de sopa!'
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
'Depois, aqui está uma cópia a limpo e assinada da nossa Valsa do Pátio e do dueto a quatro mãos.'
And from Caleb and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
'E da minha parte e do Caleb: o pregador de bétula número nove, assinado no verso por todos nós!'
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Evelyn to add on top!
'Oh, olhem o que o cartógrafo do quarto oito acabou de nos mandar com a Evelyn, para adicionar no topo!'
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
'Enquanto nós tocávamos piano, ele desenhou ao vivo todos nós vinte e oito sob as lanternas do telhado!'
Look at Graham standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
'Olhem o Graham de pé perto da porta fingindo não sorrir, desenhado a carvão!'
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.
'Coloque no canto um sachê de folhas de hortelã secas do pátio para deixar um cheiro bom.'
Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
'Daqui a trinta verões, alguém levantará esta tampa e sentirá o cheiro do chá quente de verão.'
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim — ready for the waxed linen!
'Tampa bem apertada, fita de tecido branco ao redor da borda — pronta para o linho encerado!'
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
'Vamos levá-la lá fora sob as lanternas enquanto a terceira laje ainda está nos esperando!'
Vamos ouvir mais uma vez, sem interrupções, toda a montagem da nova cápsula do tempo.
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe — both halves together!
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
And from Caleb and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Evelyn to add on top!
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
Look at Graham standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.
Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim — ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
A receita plastificada, a valsa autografada, o pregador número nove e o retrato a carvão descansam protegidos dentro da nova caixa! Nos reencontramos já no pátio.
See you in the courtyard!
